title: Hearty Crispy Argentinian Pork Tenderloin Skewers
description: Buttery and crispy pork tenderloin skewers with a crowd-pleasing flavor, featuring plant-based friendly options and score-fat for added richness, this dish is a perfect representation of Argentinian cuisine with a twist
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Cut the pork tenderloin into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and black pepper
Brush the mixture onto the pork tenderloin pieces
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Dot the top of each skewer with plant-based butter
Bake for 20 minutes or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit
Increase the oven to broil and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until crispy
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving
